title: Defense Layer Matcher
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI Agent Safety for Robotics
description: Match eight requests from an agent to the safety layer that refuses each one first. The six layers are role, rate limit, schema, workspace, confirmation and the stop state. Used in Chapter 17.

educational.topic: Defense in depth: role, rate limit, schema, workspace limits, confirmation step and the stop state
learningObjectives: Attribute each of eight agent requests to the one safety layer that refuses it first, among six layers, with at least 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Work out which of several mechanisms is responsible for a refusal, with the layer and the reason shown after each commit
keyQuestions: Which layer's rule does this request break first?
Why does a request that passes the schema still get refused?
commonMisconceptions: The schema check covers every limit
The agent can approve its own risky moves
assessmentOpportunities: Eight committed attributions; 7 of 8 for mastery

controls.label: Start / Check / Next request / See score / Try again
